<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>LIBRAS IA – Reconhecimento do Alfabeto</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&family=Syne:wght@700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/camera_utils/camera_utils.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/hands/hands.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/drawing_utils/drawing_utils.js"></script>
<style>
:root {
  --bg:      #080c10;
  --surface: #0e1620;
  --border:  #1a2d40;
  --accent:  #00e5a0;
  --accent2: #00a8ff;
  --dim:     #1a2d40;
  --text:    #c8dff0;
  --muted:   #4a6880;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
body{
  background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);
  font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
  min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;padding:20px 16px 40px;gap:0;
}

/* HEADER */
header{
  width:100%;max-width:960px;
  display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding-bottom:12px;margin-bottom:20px;
}
header h1{
  font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,4vw,2rem);
  font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-0.02em;color:var(--accent);
}
header .tag{font-size:0.62rem;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:0.12em;text-transform:uppercase;}

/* LAYOUT */
.layout{
  width:100%;max-width:960px;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 280px;gap:18px;
}
@media(max-width:720px){.layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

/* CÂMERA */
.camera-wrap{
  position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;
}
.camera-wrap video,.camera-wrap canvas{
  position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;transform:scaleX(-1);
}
.camera-wrap::before,.camera-wrap::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;width:22px;height:22px;
  border-color:var(--accent);border-style:solid;z-index:10;pointer-events:none;
}
.camera-wrap::before{top:10px;left:10px;border-width:2px 0 0 2px;}
.camera-wrap::after{bottom:10px;right:10px;border-width:0 2px 2px 0;}
.fps-dot{
  position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;width:8px;height:8px;
  border-radius:50%;background:var(--dim);z-index:15;transition:background .3s;
}
.fps-dot.on{background:var(--accent);}
#overlay{
  position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(8,12,16,0.88);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  gap:16px;z-index:20;
}
#overlay p{font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;}
button#startBtn{
  background:var(--accent);color:#000;border:none;border-radius:6px;
  padding:12px 32px;font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:0.95rem;
  font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;
  transition:opacity .15s;
}
button#startBtn:hover{opacity:0.85;}

/* PAINEL DIREITO */
.panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;}

/* LETRA GRANDE */
.letra-display{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:12px;padding:18px;text-align:center;
}
.letra-big{
  font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:100px;font-weight:800;
  color:var(--accent);line-height:1;min-height:105px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:color .15s;
}
.letra-big.idle{color:var(--dim);}
.conf-bar-wrap{margin-top:10px;}
.conf-label{
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;
  font-size:0.58rem;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:0.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:4px;
}
.conf-bar{height:4px;background:var(--border);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;}
.conf-fill{
  height:100%;background:var(--accent);border-radius:2px;
  width:0%;transition:width .12s ease;
}

/* STATS */
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;}
.stat-box{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:8px;padding:10px;text-align:center;
}
.stat-val{font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent2);}
.stat-label{font-size:0.56rem;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;}

/* HISTÓRICO */
.historico-wrap{
  width:100%;max-width:960px;margin-top:18px;
}
.section-title{
  font-size:0.58rem;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:0.15em;
  text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px;
}
.historico-box{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;
  padding:14px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:56px;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.hist-letra{
  font-family:'Syne',sans-serif;font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:800;
  color:var(--accent);animation:pop .2s ease;
}
@keyframes pop{from{transform:scale(1.5);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
.hist-cursor{
  width:2px;height:28px;background:var(--accent);
  animation:blink 1s step-end infinite;
}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:0}}
.hist-vazio{font-size:0.65rem;color:var(--muted);font-style:italic;}
.hist-controls{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-left:auto;}
.hist-btn{
  background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted);
  border-radius:5px;padding:4px 10px;font-family:'Space Mono',monospace;
  font-size:0.6rem;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase;
  transition:border-color .15s,color .15s;
}
.hist-btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent2);color:var(--accent2);}

/* IMAGEM DO ALFABETO */
.alfabeto-wrap{
  width:100%;max-width:960px;margin-top:18px;
}
.alfabeto-img{
  width:100%;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);
  background:var(--surface);
}

/* NOTA */
.nota{
  font-size:0.56rem;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;
  letter-spacing:0.05em;margin-top:8px;line-height:1.6;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <h1>LIBRAS IA</h1>
  <span class="tag">Reconhecimento do Alfabeto Manual · TCC</span>
</header>

<div class="layout">
  <!-- CÂMERA -->
  <div>
    <div class="camera-wrap" id="cameraWrap">
      <video id="video" playsinline></video>
      <canvas id="canvas"></canvas>
      <div class="fps-dot" id="fpsDot"></div>
      <div id="overlay">
        <p>Posicione sua mão na frente da câmera</p>
        <button id="startBtn">Iniciar Câmera</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="nota">
      ✱ Letras com movimento no LIBRAS (Ç, H, J, K, R, W, X, Y, Z) são reconhecidas pela posição estática de base.<br>
      Para detecção perfeita dessas letras seria necessário análise de movimento entre frames.
    </p>
  </div>

  <!-- PAINEL -->
  <div class="panel">
    <div class="letra-display">
      <div class="letra-big idle" id="letraBig">–</div>
      <div class="conf-bar-wrap">
        <div class="conf-label">
          <span>Confiança</span><span id="confPct">0%</span>
        </div>
        <div class="conf-bar"><div class="conf-fill" id="confFill"></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="stats">
      <div class="stat-box">
        <div class="stat-val" id="statFrames">0</div>
        <div class="stat-label">Frames</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-box">
        <div class="stat-val" id="statFPS">–</div>
        <div class="stat-label">FPS</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- HISTÓRICO DE LETRAS -->
<div class="historico-wrap">
  <div class="section-title">Histórico de letras detectadas</div>
  <div class="historico-box" id="historico">
    <span class="hist-vazio" id="histVazio">Aguardando detecção...</span>
    <div class="hist-cursor" id="histCursor" style="display:none"></div>
    <div class="hist-controls">
      <button class="hist-btn" onclick="apagar()">⌫ Apagar</button>
      <button class="hist-btn" onclick="limpar()">Limpar</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ALFABETO LIBRAS (imagem) -->
<div class="alfabeto-wrap">
  <div class="section-title">Alfabeto Manual – LIBRAS (referência)</div>
  <img id="imgAlf" class="alfabeto-img" alt="Alfabeto LIBRAS">
</div>


<script>
// ── Embed da imagem do alfabeto ──────────────────────────────
document.getElementById('imgAlf').src = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,';

// ── Letras com ç ────────────────────────────────────────────
const LETRAS = "ABCÇDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".split('');

// ── Histórico ────────────────────────────────────────────────
let historico = [];
let letraAnterior = null;
let letraTimer = null;
const HOLD_MS = 1800; // ms segurando a letra para confirmar no histórico

function adicionarHistorico(letra) {
  if (!letra || letra === letraAnterior) return;
  letraAnterior = letra;
  clearTimeout(letraTimer);
  letraTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    historico.push(letra);
    renderHistorico();
  }, HOLD_MS);
}

function renderHistorico() {
  const box    = document.getElementById('historico');
  const vazio  = document.getElementById('histVazio');
  const cursor = document.getElementById('histCursor');
  // remove spans antigos
  box.querySelectorAll('.hist-letra').forEach(e => e.remove());
  if (historico.length === 0) {
    vazio.style.display = '';
    cursor.style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }
  vazio.style.display = 'none';
  cursor.style.display = '';
  historico.forEach(l => {
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    span.className = 'hist-letra';
    span.textContent = l;
    box.insertBefore(span, cursor);
  });
}

function apagar() {
  historico.pop();
  renderHistorico();
}
function limpar() {
  historico = [];
  letraAnterior = null;
  renderHistorico();
}

// ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
function dist(a,b) { return Math.hypot(a.x-b.x, a.y-b.y); }

// ── RECONHECIMENTO (baseado na imagem LIBRAS real) ────────────
function reconhecer(lm) {
  const w    = lm[0];
  const base = dist(w, lm[9]);
  const T    = base * 0.36;

  // ── Dedos estendidos (tip acima do PIP) ──
  const indUp = lm[8].y  < lm[6].y;
  const medUp = lm[12].y < lm[10].y;
  const aneUp = lm[16].y < lm[14].y;
  const minUp = lm[20].y < lm[18].y;

  // ── Polegar ──
  const thumbOut  = dist(lm[4], lm[17]) > base * 1.05;
  const thumbUp   = lm[4].y < lm[2].y;

  // ── Distâncias ──
  const d_t_i  = dist(lm[4], lm[8]);
  const d_t_m  = dist(lm[4], lm[12]);
  const d_t_a  = dist(lm[4], lm[16]);
  const d_t_min= dist(lm[4], lm[20]);
  const d_t_i6 = dist(lm[4], lm[6]);

  const touchTI  = d_t_i   < T;
  const touchTM  = d_t_m   < T;
  const touchTA  = d_t_a   < T;
  const touchTMin= d_t_min  < T;

  const imSpread = dist(lm[8],  lm[12]) > base * 0.36;
  const maSpread = dist(lm[12], lm[16]) > base * 0.28;

  const allDown = !indUp && !medUp && !aneUp && !minUp;
  const allUp   =  indUp &&  medUp &&  aneUp &&  minUp;
  const onlyInd =  indUp && !medUp && !aneUp && !minUp;
  const onlyMin = !indUp && !medUp && !aneUp &&  minUp;
  const indMed  =  indUp &&  medUp && !aneUp && !minUp;

  // Dedo "gancho" (half-bent): tip abaixo do MCP mas acima do PIP+
  const indHook = !indUp && lm[8].y > lm[5].y && lm[8].y < lm[6].y + base*0.1;

  // Palma virada para baixo: pontas dos dedos abaixo do MCP correspondente
  const palmDown = lm[8].y > lm[5].y && lm[12].y > lm[9].y &&
                   lm[16].y > lm[13].y && lm[20].y > lm[17].y;

  // ═══════════════════ ALFABETO LIBRAS ══════════════════

  // A – punho fechado, polegar visível ao lado do indicador
  if (allDown && thumbOut && !touchTI) return "A";

  // B – 4 dedos estendidos, polegar dobrado
  if (allUp && !thumbOut) return "B";

  // C / Ç – mão curvada em C
  {
    const noneUp = !indUp && !medUp && !aneUp && !minUp;
    const open   = !touchTI && dist(lm[8], lm[4]) > base * 0.55;
    const partial= lm[8].y < lm[5].y + base*0.35;
    if (noneUp && open && thumbOut && partial) return "C";
  }

  // D – indicador em gancho com outros fechados (D real no LIBRAS)
  if (indHook && !medUp && !aneUp && !minUp && !thumbOut) return "D";

  // E – punho, polegar abaixo dos dedos (anéis visíveis) — similar a A
  if (allDown && !thumbOut && (touchTA || touchTM)) return "E";

  // F – polegar toca indicador (OK), outros 3 estendidos
  if (touchTI && !indUp && medUp && aneUp && minUp) return "F";

  // G – indicador apontando para cima de punho (dedo único sem polegar aberto)
  if (onlyInd && !thumbOut && !indHook) return "G";

  // H – indicador + médio (com cruzamento) → aproximar como imSpread falso
  if (indMed && !imSpread && !thumbOut) return "H";

  // I – mindinho curvo/dobrado (like small hook) — punho com mindinho levantado pouco
  if (onlyMin && !thumbOut) return "I";

  // J – punho rolando = tratar como Y estático (mindinho + polegar, com arco)
  // J com movimento: difícil; vamos tratar como Y
  // (será nota na tela)

  // K – indicador + médio estendidos com polegar aberto para cima
  if (indMed && thumbUp && thumbOut && !imSpread) return "K";

  // L – polegar + indicador formando L
  if (onlyInd && thumbOut && !indHook) return "L";

  // M – 4 dedos apontando para baixo (palma pra baixo/frente)
  if (palmDown && !thumbOut) return "M";

  // N – 3 dedos para baixo (sem mindinho)
  {
    const threeDown = lm[8].y > lm[5].y && lm[12].y > lm[9].y &&
                      lm[16].y > lm[13].y && lm[20].y < lm[17].y;
    if (threeDown && !thumbOut) return "N";
  }

  // O – todos os dedos formam O com polegar
  if (touchTI && !medUp && !aneUp && !minUp) return "O";

  // P – mão plana apontando para lado (horizonal)
  {
    const horizontal = Math.abs(lm[8].y - lm[5].y) < base * 0.22;
    if (allUp && horizontal) return "P";
  }

  // Q – dedos apontando para baixo com polegar (como M mas com polegar)
  if (palmDown && thumbOut) return "Q";

  // R – indicador + polegar tocando com médio estendido
  if (touchTI && indMed && !aneUp && !minUp) return "R";

  // S – punho fechado simples (sem polegar aparente)
  if (allDown && !thumbOut && !touchTI && !touchTA) return "S";

  // T – mão aberta com 4 dedos
  if (allUp && thumbOut) return "T";

  // U – indicador + médio juntos (sem spread)
  if (indMed && !imSpread && !thumbOut && !thumbUp) return "U";

  // V – indicador + médio afastados (vitória)
  if (indMed && imSpread && !thumbOut) return "V";

  // W – indicador + médio + anelar
  if (indUp && medUp && aneUp && !minUp && !thumbOut) return "W";

  // X – punho com movimento lateral → tratar como punho + polegar semi
  if (allDown && thumbUp && !thumbOut) return "X";

  // Y – mindinho + polegar (hang loose)
  if (!indUp && !medUp && !aneUp && minUp && thumbOut) return "Y";

  // Z – indicador tracejando Z → tratar como indicador puro + polegar
  if (onlyInd && thumbOut && indHook) return "Z";

  return null;
}

// ── Estabilização ────────────────────────────────────────────
const BUFFER_SIZE = 22;
const STABLE_MIN  = 14;
const buffer = [];

function addBuffer(letra) {
  buffer.push(letra ?? '_');
  if (buffer.length > BUFFER_SIZE) buffer.shift();
  const counts = {};
  buffer.forEach(l => { counts[l] = (counts[l]||0) + 1; });
  const [best, votes] = Object.entries(counts).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0];
  const confianca = Math.round((votes / BUFFER_SIZE) * 100);
  return { letra: best==='_' ? null : best, confianca, votes };
}

// ── UI ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function atualizarDisplay(letra, confianca, estavel) {
  const big  = document.getElementById('letraBig');
  const fill = document.getElementById('confFill');
  const pct  = document.getElementById('confPct');
  if (!letra) {
    big.textContent = '–'; big.classList.add('idle');
    fill.style.width = '0%'; pct.textContent = '0%';
    clearTimeout(letraTimer); letraAnterior = null;
    return;
  }
  big.textContent = letra; big.classList.remove('idle');
  fill.style.width = confianca + '%'; pct.textContent = confianca + '%';
  if (estavel) adicionarHistorico(letra);
}

// ── MediaPipe ────────────────────────────────────────────────
const video  = document.getElementById('video');
const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
const ctx    = canvas.getContext('2d');
const fpsDot = document.getElementById('fpsDot');

const hands = new Hands({
  locateFile: file => `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/hands/${file}`
});

hands.setOptions({
  maxNumHands: 1, modelComplexity: 1,
  minDetectionConfidence: 0.65,
  minTrackingConfidence:  0.55
});

let frameCount=0, fpsTimer=Date.now(), fpsCount=0;

hands.onResults(results => {
  canvas.width  = video.videoWidth  || 640;
  canvas.height = video.videoHeight || 480;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);

  frameCount++;
  document.getElementById('statFrames').textContent = frameCount;
  fpsCount++;
  if (Date.now()-fpsTimer >= 1000) {
    document.getElementById('statFPS').textContent = fpsCount;
    fpsCount=0; fpsTimer=Date.now();
  }
  fpsDot.classList.toggle('on', frameCount%2===0);

  if (!results.multiHandLandmarks || !results.multiHandLandmarks.length) {
    addBuffer(null); atualizarDisplay(null,0,false); return;
  }
  const lm = results.multiHandLandmarks[0];
  drawConnectors(ctx, lm, HAND_CONNECTIONS, {color:'rgba(0,229,160,0.45)',lineWidth:2});
  drawLandmarks(ctx, lm, {color:'#00e5a0',fillColor:'rgba(0,168,255,0.55)',lineWidth:1,radius:4});

  const bruta = reconhecer(lm);
  const {letra, confianca, votes} = addBuffer(bruta);
  const estavel = votes >= STABLE_MIN && letra !== null;
  atualizarDisplay(letra, confianca, estavel);
});

document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  document.getElementById('overlay').style.display = 'none';
  const camera = new Camera(video, {
    onFrame: async () => { await hands.send({image: video}); },
    width: 640, height: 480
  });
  camera.start().catch(err => {
    document.getElementById('overlay').style.display='flex';
    alert('Erro ao acessar câmera: ' + err.message);
  });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
